correctness.rationale: The exterior Euler-Koszul sequence identifies E with the surjective contraction kernel of Omega^2(3) to O(1). On a projective plane, Omega^2(3) splits as O plus Omega^1(2)^3 plus O(1)^3; the projection of omega into wedge^2(V/H) is the O(1)^3 component. Nonzero projection splits off O(1), yielding h0(E(-1))=2. Zero projection is precisely the Lagrangian condition, and a complementary Lagrangian splitting yields h0=3. The symplectic Lagrangian locus is smooth of dimension six. The exact checker treats coordinate cases only.
